properties.name: SUB loading dock-side entrance
properties.note: Door beside the loading dock in the UASU 2024 main-floor PDF; aligned to SUB's north wall. The public passage runs beside the dock, not through it.
Short schematic connection across the loading-side apron from the PDF doorway to the south endpoint of mapped crossing way/1534778792. Reuses the crossing rather than inventing a new road crossing.
Indoor doorway connection across CAB's north wall into Gunning/Lemieux Chemistry Centre. Schematic alignment; door position is not surveyed.
CAB–SAB ground-level enclosed passage. The east–west path passes underneath; only the west door is an access junction.
Connect the mapped west entrance (node/12146744181) to the enclosed passage.
Indoor connection through the shared SAB–University Commons wall in SAB's southeast wing. Schematic corridor alignment; door positions are not surveyed.

Indoor connection through CCIS's narrow southward extension into Gunning/Lemieux Chemistry Centre. The interior junction at the north end of the extension allows a turn into CCIS without visiting an exterior entrance. Schematic corridor alignment; door positions are not surveyed.

Indoor connection through CCIS's northward extension into the North Lecture Theatres. Interior turning points avoid detours to the extension's exterior doors. Schematic corridor alignment; door positions are not surveyed.

Indoor connection from the North Lecture Theatres through the upper angled shared wall into Biological Sciences. Interior turning points continue into Biology's connecting wing. Schematic corridor alignment; door positions are not surveyed.
